title: SupplierConfig
description: Landed-cost adders and constraints that vary by supplier — freight, duty, tariff, MOLV, MOQ. Independent of the cost access sequence (which picks WHICH cost candidate to use): this is what gets added on top once a supplier is known for the line. One (region, salesOrg, supplier) triple = one versioned, effective-dated document, scoped exactly like region-config. supplier "*" is a region-wide default; a specific supplier only needs its own document where its terms actually diverge.

supplier.description: A specific supplier id (e.g. "ACME"), or "*" for a region-wide default used when the item's supplier has no override.

freight.description: Overrides the part's freight adder for this supplier, if set.

molv.description: Minimum order line value for this supplier.

moq.description: Minimum order quantity for this supplier — informational (see constraint.schema.json kind MIN_QTY), never silently changes price.
